text_pending_judge.text: Chevron says low prices could negatively affect its upstream earnings, cash flows and capital expenditure programs, as well as its production and proved reserves, and that upstream assets may become impaired. Downstream earnings could also be hurt because they depend on refined product supply, demand and margins.

Chevron says impairment determinations rest on highly uncertain estimates, such as future commodity prices and the supply-and-demand outlook. It also says a sensitivity analysis of earnings under other impairment assumptions is not practicable.
